title: NMOS current mirror
description: Design a simple two-transistor NMOS current mirror (diode-connected reference device mirroring a 50 uA reference current at nominally 1:1 ratio) whose output current stays within +/-10% of the 50 uA reference across the full sky130-style tt/ss/ff process corner, 1.62-1.98 V supply, and -40..125 C temperature matrix, with the output node held mid-swing.

target_specs.corners: sky130-style tt/ss/ff process x 1.62-1.98V supply x -40..125C

reference.notes: Generic (non-PDK) NMOS model stands in for sky130 devices -- see mirror.spice/models.lib headers and README.md's 'Known limitation' note.

source.citation: Current mirror is a standard first analog IC design course topic; framed here in the style of AnalogCoder's (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) easy-tier task set, not reproduced from that repo (unlicensed).
